description: A Kivy application example demonstrating how to size Labels to their content and control text wrapping using texture_size and text_size properties.

classes.name: LabelTextureSizeExample
classes.description: Main application class demonstrating label sizing and text wrapping.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Loads the KV language string and initializes the app.

methods.name: on_start
methods.description: Initializes text content widgets and resets words.

methods.name: reset_words
methods.description: Resets the text content to the initial title and starts adding words.

methods.name: add_word
methods.description: Adds the next word to each content widget with a delay based on word length.
